panels.description: Colorado logistics terminal: Roman submits an Antarctic transport request. The route display clearly identifies FALCON — FIELD SITE and NEXUS — COASTAL CAVE LABORATORY, TWO HOURS, WEATHER DEPENDENT. His bonded TJ waits beside the terminal. Keep silent.
Roman signs the CSG ANTARCTIC LOGISTICS / NEXUS ACCESS authorization. His bonded TJ remains beside him. Leave upper-right clear.
A tracked transport leaves the Colorado terminal. Roman sits behind the windshield with his bonded TJ secured in a padded case, its screen visible. Keep silent.
Split route map: Sitara and Nayah depart Falcon on one line while Roman’s Antarctic logistics route enters from another; the lines converge only at NEXUS. Keep Falcon and Nexus visibly separate.
